normalized.description: There is currently a limited understanding of the cloud feedbacks and precipitation in climate models and numerical weather predictions, which is a major source of uncertainty. To reduce this uncertainty, a better characterization of cloud and precipitation vertical structure is required. A solution consists of combining measurements from multi-frequency radars with frequencies ranging from 10 GHz to above 200 GHz. Therefore, inclusion of G-band would be highly beneficial for retrieval of several new scientific products. The G-band radar will require a high transmitted power. The 238 GHz solid-state power amplifier has been identified as key risk areafor which early technology assessment needs to be undertaken. The activity aims to develop and test a breadboard of a solid-state power amplifier at 238 GHz based on state-of-the-art technologies providing 250 mW of saturated output power.
